title: Design your first sequence
story: ProteinMPNN reads a backbone and designs sequences that should fold into it. Design one sequence for inputs/{{target}}.pdb, writing results to outputs. ProteinMPNN needs the proteinmpnn conda environment. A small run like this is fine without a GPU.

lesson.title: Running ProteinMPNN

parts.note: Run a Python script with the python of the active environment (proteinmpnn), which has PyTorch installed.
The script, by its full path, since it isn't on your PATH.
The backbone to design sequences for.
Where to write. The sequences go in outputs/seqs/{{target}}.fa.

lesson.why: ProteinMPNN is small and fast, so one structure takes seconds even on a CPU. Hundreds of structures belong in a Slurm job.
lesson.without: With the base environment or none, Python can't find PyTorch: "No module named 'torch'".

tasks.text: Design a sequence for inputs/{{target}}.pdb into outputs

hints: Then `cat outputs/seqs/{{target}}.fa` to see the result. The first record is the original sequence.
